name: Emílio Garrastazu Médici
contribution: A Brazilian military leader and dictator who was the 28th president of Brazil from 1969 to 1974.

checks.lead: Emílio Garrastazu Médici (Portuguese pronunciation: [eˈmilju ɡɐʁastaˈzu ˈmɛd(ʒi)si]; 4 December 1905 – 9 October 1985) was a Brazilian military leader and dictator who was the 28th president of Brazil from 1969 to 1974. His authoritarian rule marked the apex of the Brazilian military regime.
